scenes.title: Teens spend $2,350 a year
scenes.sub: So where does it all go?

lines.say: Did you know the average U.S. teen says they spend about two thousand three hundred fifty dollars a year?
lines.show: Did you know the average U.S. teen says they spend about $2,350 a year?

lines.say: So where does it all go?
lines.show: So where does it all go?

lines.say: That's up six percent from last year, and it works out to about forty-five dollars a week.
lines.show: That's up 6% from last year, and it works out to about $45 a week.

lines.say: Clothing takes about twenty-one percent of the average teen's spending.
lines.show: Clothing takes about 21% of the average teen's spending.

lines.say: And for teen girls, beauty is now twenty-three percent of their spending. That's a survey high.
lines.show: And for teen girls, beauty is now 23% of their spending. That's a survey high.

scenes.heading: Athletic brands' share of teen fashion

lines.say: Meanwhile, big athletic brands are losing ground.
lines.show: Meanwhile, big athletic brands are losing ground.

lines.say: Their share of teen fashion fell from forty-four percent three years ago to twenty-nine percent now.
lines.show: Their share of teen fashion fell from 44% three years ago to 29% now.

lines.say: Brands watch these numbers closely. So should you.
lines.show: Brands watch these numbers closely. So should you.

lines.say: Cutting just ten dollars a week adds up to five hundred twenty dollars a year.
lines.show: Cutting just $10 a week adds up to $520 a year.

scenes.takeaway: Small cuts add up. Know where your money goes.
scenes.source: Data: Piper Sandler Taking Stock With Teens, fall 2026 (about 9,000 U.S. teens, self-reported)

lines.say: Follow H Flick for more money facts like this.
lines.show: Follow HFLIC for more money facts like this.
